They were led by head coach, [[Anthony Grant (basketball)|Anthony Grant]], in his sixth season with the Flyers. The Flyers played their home games at [[UD Arena]] in [[Dayton, Ohio]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 20–11, 12–6 in [[2022–23 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 Play]] to finish a three-way tie for 2nd place. They defeated [[2022–23 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Saint Joseph's]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|Atlantic 10 tournament]] and [[2022–23 Fordham Rams men's basketball team|Fordham]] in the semifinals before losing in the championship game to [[2022–23 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]]. They preemptively declined any postseason invitations, making it unclear whether they were poised to join the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] field.{{cite web |last=Jablonski |first=David |title=Dayton’s season ends as it announces it ‘will decline any postseason opportunities’ |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/daytons-season-ends-as-it-announces-it-will-decline-any-postseason-opportunities/6ZWLRE5QXBB43PXSLAYARCFBNI/ |website=DaytonDailyNews.com |publisher=Dayton Daily News |access-date=25 March 2023}} ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Flyers]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 24–11, 14–4 in [[2021–22 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a tie for second place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2022 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]], they defeated [[2021–22 UMass Minutemen basketball team|UMass]] in the quarterfinals before losing in the semifinals to [[2021–22 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]]. They were one of the last four teams not selected for the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]{{Cite web |last=Jablonski |first=David |title=Dayton narrowly misses NCAA tournament at-large berth |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/dayton-narrowly-misses-ncaa-tournament-at-large-berth/ACUFIKNCW5C75BZJEIVE4RWHJQ/ |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=dayton-daily-news |language=English}} and received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]].{{Cite web |last=Tisdell |first=John |date=2022-03-14 |title=Dayton will play at Toledo as a top seed in the 2022 NIT |url=https://www.whio.com/sports/dayton-will-play-toledo-top-seed-2022-nit/OAY2JDTRQFHIBMFGWLSE4NY5PI |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=WHIO TV 7 and WHIO Radio |language=en}} There they defeated [[2021–22 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]] in the first round{{Cite web |title=Dayton vs. Toledo - Game Recap - March 16, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401411707 |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} before losing in the second round to [[2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].{{Cite web |title=Dayton vs. Vanderbilt - Game Recap - March 20, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401411708 |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
